input_schema_assumptions: Stable preprocess_v1/preprocess_manifest.json is the only namespace resolver; P0-prime never hand-enters the pose cache namespace.
The stable manifest has cache_binding.cache_run_manifest and cache_binding.preprocess_index path/SHA records; the index building_manifest_path column resolves each per-building manifest.
The index columns are processing_order, building_id, tier, cohort, status, data_root, building_manifest_path, building_manifest_sha256, views_n, seed_points_n, class2_n, class6_n, and pose_sha256.
Manifest root schema is jointbuildgs.fusion_w1.preprocess_building.v1 and status is PASSED.
building contains building_id, processing_order, tier, and cohort.
seed.source_points_n equals seed.output_points_n, seed.downsample_applied is false, and seed.classification_counts has only string keys 2 and 6.
seed.base_las contains repo-relative path, sha256, crs=EPSG:25832, and vertical_datum=orthometric.
The base LAS is LAS 1.4 with RGB and is already classified; P0-prime validates it byte-for-byte and does not run SMRF or overlay again.
The trainer canonical NPZ and supervision artifacts are outside P0-prime; only seed.base_las is consumed.
